statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); total_input=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); total_output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); dir_display="📁 $dir_name"; git_branch=""; if git -C "$current_dir" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_branch="$branch"; fi; context_cost_info=""; if [ -n "$remaining" ]; then used=$(echo "100 - $remaining" | bc); u=$(printf "%.0f" "$used"); input_cost=$(echo "scale=4; $total_input * 3 / 1000000" | bc); output_cost=$(echo "scale=4; $total_output * 15 / 1000000" | bc); total_cost=$(echo "scale=2; $input_cost + $output_cost" | bc); context_cost_info=" | Context: ${u}% | Cost: \$${total_cost}"; fi; LIGHT_CYAN='\033[96m'; ORANGE='\033[38;5;214m'; RESET='\033[0m'; if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "${LIGHT_CYAN}[%s]${RESET} %s ${ORANGE}%s${RESET}%s" "$model" "$dir_display" "$git_branch" "$context_cost_info"; else printf "${LIGHT_CYAN}[%s]${RESET} %s%s" "$model" "$dir_display" "$context_cost_info"; fi
